# Yangjae Hyundai → Sadang → Isu road preview

Source: © OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
Data license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0.
Downloaded 2026-11-02 from the OSM map API in 12 small tiles.

Route: Heolleung-ro near Hyundai Yangjae campus → Yangjae-daero →
Gangnam Ring westbound / Seocho tunnel → Sadang IC exit → Gwacheon-daero →
Sadang station intersection → Dongjak-daero → Isu station.
The start is on the public road near the campus, not inside its driveway.
42 external edges, 7448.74 m (intersection-internal lengths excluded).

`corridor.net.xml` and `route.json` are the offline runtime source assets.
`road_builder.build()` copies the corridor and writes the empty road preview,
route r0, cyan route overlays, landmark markers and an overview camera.
With ROAD.preview_traffic enabled, ordinary passenger vehicles are prefilled on
the selected route and enter every six seconds. No RL vehicle is added.
The existing highway RL environment is NOT yet adapted to this multi-edge map.

Geometry, directions, lane counts and road names come from OSM where available.
Missing road attributes use SUMO defaults. Signal programs are generated by
netconvert, not the actual Seoul timing plans. Bus lane schedules, stop locations,
construction, live congestion and human driving behaviors are not implemented.
The expanded extract retains edges within roughly 200 m of the selected route
plus adjacent junction mouths (1026 external edges). Whole edges may extend
beyond the buffer. This includes opposite carriageways and side streets, but
does not constitute a complete district model. The preview starts at Sadang
with a target view width of 320 m. Traffic on cross streets is not yet populated.
lane_audit.json records per-edge lane counts, source tags and lane connections.
32 of 42 selected route edges lack explicit lane-count tags in this snapshot;
these are still defaults and need street-view verification. OSM completeness
is not guaranteed. This expansion does not validate actual lane counts, turning
restrictions, bus-lane rules or signal timing.

Reproduction: download_map.py → netconvert OSM import → prepare_corridor.py.
Import options: --keep-edges.by-vclass passenger --geometry.remove
--junctions.join --tls.guess-signals --tls.discard-simple --tls.join
--tls.default-type actuated --output.street-names --output.original-names.
Full source and import logs remain here for auditing; no download is needed
when running view_road.py. before-route.patch preserves the earlier local edits.
